built: SBGN-ML 0.3 Process Description exporter over a final_mapped-schema payload: sbgn_export(payload, ir=None) -> (text, report), sbgn_text(payload, *, ir=None), write_sbgn. Pure (stdlib ElementTree, no network/DB/LLM). Compartment glyph per subcellular location used ('unspecified' when a state has none), one entity glyph per (entity, compartment): simple chemical / macromolecule / complex (members nested) / nucleic acid feature. Reaction and transport -> process glyph with consumption, production, catalysis (enzymes, transporters, catalyst-role modifiers) and stimulation/inhibition/modulation arcs (modifier roles, interactions). Interaction arcs only for a closed list of regulatory relationships and only to a process the target entity itself catalyses or transports, or a process named as the target. Database ids from mapped_ids go in <extension><t2pw:ids .../>. Positions from the PWML IR when given, else a deterministic grid; entities missing from the IR fall back to the grid.

review_round_1.verdict_received: CHANGES_REQUESTED (opus/high); product call VD-8: no arc may assert regulation the paper did not state
review_round_1.F1: _rel_class replaced by a closed word-prefix list on lower-cased text with '_' as a space: activat*/stimulat*/upregulat* -> stimulation; inhibit*/downregulat*/repress*/deactivat*/inactivat* -> inhibition (choice: deactivat*/inactivat* read as inhibition, since the sign is certain); modif*/regulat*/modulat*/cofactor* -> modulation; all else omitted and counted as relationship_not_regulatory. Catalysis branch dropped. The same list applies to reaction-modifier roles (catalyst/enzyme/empty -> catalysis; unknown role -> no arc, counted role_not_regulatory). Relationship is checked before endpoint resolution, so a non-regulatory relationship is always counted under that reason.
review_round_1.F2: Complex-membership traversal deleted. Fan-out: interactions that produced more than one arc are counted (report.exported.interactions_multi_arc; 97 files: 2 of the 5 exported interactions).
review_round_1.F3: report.notes.transport_same_compartment (97 files: 6; includes transports whose from and to states are both missing and so both fall in 'unspecified').
review_round_1.F4: report.compartment_collisions {label: number of distinct (species, cell_type, tissue) states merged}; 9 of 97 files, 12 compartments.
review_round_1.F5: report.notes counts compartment_assumed:transporter_in_from_compartment (37), compartment_assumed:interaction_source_in_target_compartment (2) and compartment_assumed:reaction_state_from_ir (79, reaction without a state placed by the IR reaction's state; formerly unreported).
review_round_1.F6: test_transport_across_two_compartments asserts the consumption arc's source glyph is in the from-compartment and the production arc's target glyph in the to-compartment.

dead_ends: Brief says runlist.json[idx]; the IR index is into the q=true subset of runlist.json (152 entries), not the raw 192-entry list. Using the raw list pairs an IR with the wrong payload.

lxml.isoschematron.Schematron rejects sbgn_pd.sch as published; building the XSLT directly with iso_svrl_for_xslt1 compiles but fires zero rules (silent no-op, gives false 'valid'). Fixed by in-memory edits and verifying 70 rules fire.
Reading JSON with the default encoding fails (cp1252) on some final_mapped.json; use utf-8.
open_questions: Only 5 of 188 interactions now become arcs. 86 are non-regulatory relationships (mostly binding); 97 regulate an entity that catalyses no process in the payload (often a protein that is only a member of a catalysing complex). SBGN PD modulation arcs must end at a process. Showing these needs another SBGN language (Entity Relationship) or an invented process node; product owner to decide.
Reactions without biological_state: 79 are placed by the IR reaction's state, and 11 of 97 files still have an 'unspecified' compartment. Whether to drop those glyphs is a product call.
